entities.summary: Kunzang, in full Kuntu Zangpo, was a prince of the Rinpungpa Dynasty that wielded power in Tsang from approximately 1440 to 1479. Born into the royal family of the Rinpungpa Dynasty, Kunzang rose to prominence during the tumultuous period of the 15th century in the Tibetan plateau. His reign was marked by a series of political maneuvers aimed at consolidating power and asserting the dominance of the Rinpungpa Dynasty over its rivals. Kunzang's strategic alliances and military campaigns allowed him to expand the dynasty's influence, but ultimately, his reign was cut short by the eventual downfall of the Rinpungpa Dynasty in the late 15th century. Kunzang's legacy as a regional leader and military commander has endured, with his name becoming synonymous with bravery and strategic brilliance in Tibetan history. The exact circumstances of his birth and death remain unknown, adding to the enigma surrounding his figure.
